title: Lear Wins 2026 Automotive News PACE Award for Modular Thermal Comfort Technologies
body_markdown:
**SOUTHFIELD, Mich., Nov. 18, 2026** — Lear Corporation (NYSE: LEA), a global automotive leader in Seating and E-Systems, announced that its Modular Thermal Comfort Systems have received a 2026 Automotive News PACE Award, recognizing the company's advancements in automotive seating technology.


“Winning a PACE Award is a testament to our team’s ability to rethink what’s possible in automotive seating,” said Ray Scott, President and Chief Executive Officer of Lear Corporation. “By combining our expertise in seating, thermal comfort and advanced manufacturing, we’ve developed an innovative solution that improves the consumer experience while helping our customers reduce complexity and cost. This recognition reflects our continued focus on bringing differentiated technologies to market.”


Lear’s award-winning Modular Thermal Comfort Systems include ComfortFlex™ and ComfortMax Seat by Lear™. ComfortFlex combines two or more thermal comfort functions such as heating, ventilation and massage into a simplified, modular system, while ComfortMax integrates these features directly into the seat trim to support automated assembly. Advantages include:


• **Enhanced comfort:** Faster heating and cooling response, improved ventilation and more effective massage performance.


• **Reduced complexity and cost:** Up to 50% fewer components and approximately 20% cost savings, depending on vehicle configuration.


• **Manufacturing efficiency:** Automated assembly that streamlines production and reduces manufacturing steps.


• **Greater design flexibility:** Adaptable solutions for a wide range of vehicle platforms and seating configurations.


The technology leverages Lear’s vertically integrated seating capabilities in materials, electronics, thermal management and advanced manufacturing. It also demonstrates IDEA by Lear, the company’s strategy to integrate Innovation, Digitalization, Engineering and Automation to advance product development and manufacturing.


First introduced in 2024, Lear’s Modular Thermal Comfort Systems have been selected for programs across 17 global automakers and 47 vehicle programs, demonstrating commercial demand for solutions that combine premium comfort with simplified manufacturing.


The Automotive News PACE Awards honor superior innovation, technological advancement and business performance by automotive suppliers. This award, judged by an independent panel of technologists, is recognized around the world as the industry benchmark for innovation.


**About Lear Corporation**


Lear Corporation (NYSE: LEA) is a global automotive leader in Seating and E-Systems. The company designs, manufactures, and delivers advanced technologies to the world’s major automakers. Building on more than 100 years of heritage, Lear is the largest U.S.-based automotive supplier, headquartered in Southfield, Michigan. Driven by a commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and sustainability, Lear’s global team of talented employees is shaping the future of mobility by developing solutions that enhance comfort, safety, and efficiency. More information is available at Lear.com.
